note: Each case carries a 'fn' selector alongside input/want. This file covers ONLY the timezone-INDEPENDENT parts of severity.ts — bucketLabel, fmtDurationLeft, isSameDay, findingSeverity, and staleStamp's pure formatting half (given an already-computed minutesAgo, as 'staleStampFromMinutes' — the Swift twin is BoardTime.staleStampText(minutesAgo:)). minutesOfDay/minutesAgo/minutesUntil/isStale/fmtHMFromIso/fmtDowFromIso read a wall-clock hour/minute off the DEVICE'S OWN timezone (JS `new Date(iso).getHours()`) and are deliberately NOT vector-tested here, since the 'want' would depend on the machine running the test. isSameDay pins that it is a LITERAL date-prefix string compare, not a real cross-timezone same-day check: two ISO instants with the same YYYY-MM-DD prefix but wildly different UTC offsets still compare equal.

bucketLabel: weekly_scoped uses the uppercased first character of scope, not the whole word
bucketLabel: weekly_scoped with a missing scope falls back to ?
bucketLabel: weekly_scoped with an empty-string scope falls back to ?
bucketLabel: an unrecognized kind passes through verbatim (bucket-agnostic)
fmtDurationLeft: zero minutes
fmtDurationLeft: under an hour still shows the leading 0
fmtDurationLeft: exactly one hour
fmtDurationLeft: hours and minutes both nonzero
fmtDurationLeft: one minute short of a full day

isSameDay: same date prefix, wildly different offsets, still compares equal (literal prefix compare, not a real cross-timezone check)
isSameDay: different date prefixes
findingSeverity: critical maps to crit
findingSeverity: warning maps to warn
findingSeverity: info maps to calm (a watched lane is a feature, not a fault)
